worlds.name: World 1: 完全倒装
worlds.description: 掌握完全倒装句式的识别与应用

levels.name: Level 1: There be & 变体
levels.description: There be 句型及其变体的倒装用法
knowledge: There be 句型本身就是倒装结构
There 位于句首，be 动词在后
There seems/appears/happens to be 等变体

learningQuestions.question: There _______ a lot of books on the shelf.
learningQuestions.explanation: 主语是 a lot of books，be动词用 are

learningQuestions.question: There _______ many reasons for his success.
learningQuestions.explanation: 主语是 many reasons，be动词用 are

practiceQuestions.question: There _______ a big tree in front of the house.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 主语是单数 a big tree，用 is

practiceQuestions.question: 翻译：桌上有三个苹果。
options: There is three apples on the table.
There are three apples on the table.
Three apples are on the table.
There have three apples on the table.
practiceQuestions.explanation: There be 结构表示存在，主语是复数用 are

levels.name: Level 2: 地点/方向副词倒装
levels.description: 地点和方向副词置于句首的倒装
knowledge: Here/There/Now/Then 等副词置于句首
句子需完全倒装
主语必须是名词，不能是代词

learningQuestions.question: Here _______ the bus.
learningQuestions.explanation: Here置于句首，动词comes置于主语the bus之前

learningQuestions.question: There _______ the famous singer.
learningQuestions.explanation: There置于句首，动词goes置于主语之前

practiceQuestions.question: Now _______ your turn.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Now置于句首，动词comes置于主语your turn之前

levels.name: Level 3: 表语前置倒装
levels.description: 表语置于句首的完全倒装用法
knowledge: 形容词、分词、介词短语作表语置于句首
强调表语的内容
句子需完全倒装

learningQuestions.question: Lying on the floor _______ a wounded soldier.
learningQuestions.explanation: 分词短语Lying on the floor置于句首，be动词was后置

learningQuestions.question: Present at the meeting _______ many experts.
learningQuestions.explanation: 形容词短语Present at the meeting置于句首，be动词were后置

practiceQuestions.question: Standing by the door _______ a tall man.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 现在分词短语Standing by the door置于句首，be动词后置

practiceQuestions.question: 翻译：房间坐满了学生。
options: Students sit full in the room.
The room was filled with students.
Seated in the room were many students.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Seated in the room置于句首，be动词were后置

worlds.name: World 2: 部分倒装（否定与限定）
worlds.description: 掌握否定词和限定词引起的部分倒装

levels.name: Level 4: 否定副词开头
levels.description: Never/Seldom/Not until 等否定副词句首倒装
knowledge: Never/Seldom/Rarely/Not until 等否定副词置于句首
句子需部分倒装（助动词/情态动词前置）
时态要与原句保持一致

learningQuestions.question: Never _______ I seen such a beautiful sunset.
learningQuestions.explanation: Never置于句首，现在完成时需倒装，助动词have前置

learningQuestions.question: Seldom _______ he go to the cinema.
learningQuestions.explanation: Seldom置于句首，一般现在时需倒装，助动词does前置

practiceQuestions.question: Not until midnight _______ he finish his homework.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Not until置于句首，一般过去时需倒装，助动词did前置

practiceQuestions.question: Rarely _______ we see such talent.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Rarely置于句首，一般现在时需倒装，助动词do前置

levels.name: Level 5: Only+状语
levels.description: Only + 状语置于句首的倒装用法
knowledge: Only + 副词/介词短语/状语从句置于句首
主句需部分倒装
从句不倒装，仅主句倒装

learningQuestions.question: Only then _______ he realize his mistake.
learningQuestions.explanation: Only then置于句首，一般过去时需倒装，助动词did前置

learningQuestions.question: Only in this way _______ we solve the problem.
learningQuestions.explanation: Only + 介词短语置于句首，情态动词can前置

practiceQuestions.question: Only when he arrived _______ he find the truth.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Only + 时间状语从句置于句首，主句部分倒装

practiceQuestions.question: 翻译：只有你努力工作，你才能成功。
options: Only if you work hard you can succeed.
Only if you work hard can you succeed.
Only you work hard can you succeed.
You can succeed only if you work hard.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Only if置于句首，主句部分倒装，情态动词can前置

levels.name: Level 6: 虚拟语气省略 if
levels.description: 虚拟语气中省略 if 的倒装用法
knowledge: Were/Had/Should 置于句首代替 if
条件句中的 if 省略
句子部分倒装

learningQuestions.question: _______ I in your position, I would accept the offer.
learningQuestions.explanation: 虚拟语气中省略 if，Were 提到句首

learningQuestions.question: _______ I known the truth earlier, I would have told you.
learningQuestions.explanation: 虚拟语气中省略 if，Had 提到句首

practiceQuestions.question: _______ it rain tomorrow, we would cancel the picnic.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 虚拟语气中省略 if，Should 提到句首

practiceQuestions.question: 翻译：如果我有钱，我就买那辆车。
options: Had I money, I would buy that car.
Were I to have money, I would buy that car.
Did I have money, I would buy that car.
If I had money, I would buy that car.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 虚拟语气中省略 if，Were 提到句首

worlds.name: World 3: 部分倒装（结构与特殊）
worlds.description: 掌握特殊句式结构引起的倒装

levels.name: Level 7: So/Nor/Neither 结构
knowledge: So/Nor/Neither + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语
表示相同或相反的情况
部分倒装结构

learningQuestions.question: So fast _______ he run that I couldn't catch him.
learningQuestions.explanation: So + 副词置于句首，助动词did前置

learningQuestions.question: Nor _______ I want to go.
learningQuestions.explanation: Nor置于句首表示也不，一般现在时需倒装，助动词do前置

practiceQuestions.question: Neither _______ he agree to the plan.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Neither置于句首表示也不，一般现在时需倒装，助动词does前置

practiceQuestions.question: So loudly _______ she speak that everyone could hear.
practiceQuestions.explanation: So + 副词置于句首，助动词did前置

levels.name: Level 8: as/though 让步倒装
levels.description: as/though 引导的让步状语从句倒装
knowledge: 形容词/副词/名词/动词 + as/though + 主语 + 谓语
表示虽然/尽管
前置部分通常不带冠词

learningQuestions.question: Child as he _______ , he knows a lot.
learningQuestions.explanation: 名词 + as 引导让步状语从句，be动词后置

learningQuestions.question: Hard as he _______ , he failed the exam.
learningQuestions.explanation: 副词 + as 引导让步状语从句，动词后置

practiceQuestions.question: Young as he _______ , he is very wise.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 形容词 + as 引导让步状语从句，be动词后置

practiceQuestions.question: 翻译：尽管他很穷，但他很快乐。
options: Poor as he is, he is happy.
As poor he is, he is happy.
Though he is poor, he is happy.
Poor though is he, he is happy.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 形容词 + as 引导让步状语从句，形容词前置

levels.name: Level 9: So/Such...that & May 祝愿
levels.description: So/Such...that 句型和祝愿句的倒装
knowledge: So/Such 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装
May + 主语 + 动词原形 表示祝愿
May 置于句首

learningQuestions.question: So excited _______ he that he couldn't sleep.
learningQuestions.explanation: So + 形容词置于句首，be动词was前置

learningQuestions.question: May you _______ success!
learningQuestions.explanation: May置于句首表示祝愿，动词用原形

practiceQuestions.question: Such a good book _______ it that I read it twice.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Such + 名词短语置于句首，be动词is前置

完全倒装.定义: 将整个谓语动词置于主语之前
常见结构: 表语置于句首（形容词/分词/介词短语）
注意事项: 主语必须是名词，代词不倒装
谓语动词通常是 be, come, go, stand, lie 等

部分倒装.定义: 仅将助动词、情态动词或be动词置于主语之前
常见结构: 否定副词句首（Never, Seldom, Not until等）
注意事项: 时态要与原句保持一致
从句不倒装，仅主句倒装
